improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including pricing and the free search offer sets expectations and attracts qualified visitors.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional trade guidance. Try three free searches and see the difference."
improvements.rationale: The headline positions Gideon as a collaborative partner rather than just a tool, building trust with business professionals. The subheading concisely communicates the three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, trade guidance) and includes a clear, low-friction CTA by highlighting the free trial offer. This removes ambiguity about what users get and encourages immediate engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition, pricing options, and member benefits upfront, it reduces uncertainty, builds trust, and encourages conversion by highlighting value and the annual savings incentive.
